info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Devillin Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Devillin Drill Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed records for Devillin drill products. This API enables users to submit comprehensive information about each drill, ensuring accurate and up-to-date catalog entries. Typical consumers include inventory managers and product catalog administrators who require an efficient means to enhance and streamline their product offerings. With this API, businesses can maintain a detailed and organized catalog of Devillin drills, supporting better inventory management and customer engagement.

post.summary: Create details for a Devillin drill.
post.description: This operation allows you to create detailed information for a Devillin drill, providing necessary specifications and attributes to enhance the operational understanding of the drill.

requestBody.description: Request body to create or update details for a Devillin drill operation. This operation allows you to submit various attributes related to the drill, ensuring that the system has the most up-to-date information for processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully and details returned.

CreateCatalogDevillinDrillDetailRequest.title: Devillin Drill Details Request

devillin_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the Devillin drill.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the drill operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the drill.

CreateCatalogDevillinDrillDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating a Devillin drill operation.

CreateCatalogDevillinDrillDetailResponse.title: Operations Post Response

status.description: The status of the operation indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the record that was processed.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The count of records that matched the operation's criteria.

CreateCatalogDevillinDrillDetailResponse.description: Schema representing the response of the Operations POST request, detailing the status of the operation, associated record ID, processing timestamp, and count of matched records.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource that is being returned. It helps clients understand how to interpret the content of the response.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This can be useful for performance monitoring and optimization.
